svg.title: 01 | The repaired clock exposes a mostly negative surface
svg.desc: TF001R2 · 11 instruments × 8 native timeframes · 2020–2023 Discovery · 25 of 88 cells positive Each number is a cell mean from its original archived telemetry; all 152,753 closed trades are retained. Color scale is symmetric, ±0.45R. M15: 0/11 positive. H4: 7/11 positive, but pooled mean only +0.00633 price R/trade. Overlapping jobs are not a portfolio. Price R does not establish net account economics; 74 invalid-risk denominators recorded zero R. No new OOS or best-cell promotion. Source B22.
